records.command:
$env:PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8'
$winnerProtocol = Get-Content docs/benchmarks/2026-10-08-winner-protocol.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$winnerCandidates = @('lexical') + @($winnerProtocol.models | ForEach-Object { $_.id })
foreach ($winnerCandidate in $winnerCandidates) {
  $winnerSlug = $winnerCandidate.Replace('/','--')
  & .dip-local/laya-env/Scripts/python.exe scripts/winner-retrieval.py --protocol docs/benchmarks/2026-10-08-winner-protocol.json --model $winnerCandidate --output ".dip-local/winner-$winnerSlug.json" --cache .dip-local/semantic-cache --index-dir .dip-local/winner-index
  Write-Output "WINNER_ATTEMPT_EXIT $winnerCandidate $LASTEXITCODE"
}
